He held the WBC cruiserweight title from 2016 to 2017, and previously the British and Commonwealth light-heavyweight titles between 2010 and 2014, and the European cruiserweight title from 2015 to 2016.  As an amateur, Bellew is a three-time ABA heavyweight champion.  He made his acting debut with a supporting role in the 2015 sports drama and "Rocky" franchise spin-off, "Creed".

Rakhim Chakhkiev | Rakhim Ruslanovich Chakhkiev (Russian: Рахим Русланович Чахкиев ; born 11 January 1983) is a Russian former professional boxer who competed from 2009 to 2016.  He held the IBO cruiserweight title in 2015, the European cruiserweight title in 2014, and has challenged once for the WBC cruiserweight title in 2013.  As an amateur he won a silver medal at the 2007 World Championships and gold at the 2008 Olympics, both in the heavyweight division.
